1.web: Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.
1.asv: Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.

2.web: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
2.asv: O my soul, thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.

3.web: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
3.asv: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.

4.web: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
4.asv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another god: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.

5.web: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
5.asv: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

6.web: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
6.asv: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.

7.web: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
7.asv: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.

8.web: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
8.asv: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

9.web: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
9.asv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: My flesh also shall dwell in safety.

10.web: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
10.asv: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.

11.web: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
11.asv: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
